description: This file contains service functions that perform API calls to backend endpoints for managing land record applications, dashboards, GIS data, document uploads, payments, and notifications. It acts as an API client interface for frontend components.

methods.name: getDashboard
methods.description: Fetches dashboard summary data based on user role.

methods.name: getApplications
methods.description: Retrieves all applications for a user, with behavior depending on role.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Submits a new land record application.

methods.name: fetchGISData
methods.description: Fetches GIS data related to land records.

methods.name: uploadDocument
methods.description: Uploads a document for a specific application.

methods.name: makePayment
methods.description: Initiates a payment process for an application.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves notifications for the current user.
